items:
🏛️ **Banking & RBI Directives:**
• **Risk-Based Deposit Insurance:** DICGC replaces flat 12 paise rate with dynamic Risk-Based Premium framework.
• **Digital Payment 2FA:** Compulsory Two-Factor Authentication for all domestic cards, UPI, and wallet transactions.
• **DigiLocker Verification:** Real-time bank identity verification for high-risk digital payments.
• **NBFC Risk Weights & RPT:** Easing of infrastructure loan risk weights; alignment of Related-Party Transaction norms with Companies Act.
• **ECB 7-Day Reporting:** Authorised Dealers must file external borrowing returns within 7 calendar days.

📈 **SEBI & Capital Markets:**
• **Mutual Fund Intra-Day Borrowing:** Permitted beyond the statutory 20% net assets ceiling for settlement liquidity.
• **Demat Simplification:** Letter of Confirmation abolished; security transfer timeline compressed to 30 days.

💰 **Direct Taxes & Insurance:**
• **Income Tax Rules 2026:** Sections cut from 819➔536; 50% HRA extended to 8 metro cities; PAN high-value threshold ₹10 Lakh/yr.
• **Ind AS 117:** Mandatory financial reporting standard for all life, general, health, and reinsurance companies.

🌿 **National & Regulatory Mandates:**
• **FSSAI Perpetual Licencing:** Basic turnover exemption raised from ₹12 Lakh ➔ ₹1.5 Crore.
• **Solid Waste Management Rules 2026:** Mandatory 4-way waste segregation at source.
